detail.name: Pale Blue Flower of Sorrow
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Seed's Mindscape: "Theory of the Heart"
detail.desc2:
A card printed with a private photo of Seed.
"Guess the cockpit is still a bit too small for both of us... Stop squirming around, Proxy.
"Now I'm going to dim the lights... Keep your eyes closed until I say so!
"Okay... Proxy, promise me you won't freak out no matter what you see..."
"...Check out this bioluminescent flower — I found it in the Hollow, it's a brand-new species~ Let's come up with a name for it together~"
